title: The Moon is slowly pulling out 🌙
caption:
3.8 cm a year. We measured it with lasers 🌙📏
Share with a space nerd 👇
first_comment: Did you know the Moon is drifting away? 🌙👇
sources: NASA, Lunar Laser Ranging / Apollo 11, 14 and 15 retroreflectors; the Moon recedes about 3.8 cm per year
Williams J. G. & Boggs D. H. (2016), 'Secular tidal changes in lunar orbit and Earth rotation', Celestial Mechanics and Dynamical Astronomy 126: 89-129
NASA / ESA: tidal braking lengthens Earth's day (about 1.7-2.3 ms per century); total solar eclipses will eventually end (hundreds of millions of years)
